operation_details.item: The user's North America business unit runs its ERP on SAP.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning—are you ready for the IT architecture review, or is it still in the “everyone agrees until the slides start” phase?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Almost ready. I’m pulling together the ERP landscape across all three business units so the discussion starts with facts rather than preferences.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good approach. What’s the current setup by region?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: North America runs on SAP, Europe runs on Oracle, and Asia runs on NetSuite.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That should make for an interesting review. Are you positioning the differences as a problem to eliminate or as constraints the architecture needs to respect?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: As constraints to respect first. I’d rather test the operating model against reality than force a clean global diagram that creates friction in every region.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that the North America unit runs on SAP, while keeping the ERP details of the other units.
